# => run cannot find subprocess.
! exec govulnfilter run non-existing
! stdout .
stderr 'govulnfilter: exec: "non-existing": executable file not found in \$PATH'

# => run missing argument <govulncheck>
! exec govulnfilter run
! stdout .
stderr 'govulnfilter: run: missing <govulncheck>'

# => run exits with the same status of subprocess (unfortunately in testscript
#    we can only check that the exit status is non zero).
! exec govulnfilter run fake -exit 42
! stdout .
stderr 'govulnfilter: fake: exit status 42'

# => run debug mode stdout and stderr of subprocess
exec govulnfilter run -debug fake -stdout fruits.text -stderr sausages.text
cmp stdout fruits-stdout.text
cmp stderr sausages-stderr.text

# => run hooks stdout and stderr of govulncheck and exits with the same status
! exec govulnfilter run govulncheck
! stdout .
stderr 'govulncheck: no package patterns provided'
stderr 'govulnfilter: govulncheck: exit status 2'

# => missing go.mod
! exec govulnfilter run govulncheck ./...
! stdout .
stderr 'govulncheck: no go\.mod file'
stderr 'govulnfilter: govulncheck: exit status 1'

-- fruits.text --
banana
mango
-- fruits-stdout.text --
out> banana
out> mango
-- sausages.text --
finocchiona
culatello
-- sausages-stderr.text --
err> finocchiona
err> culatello
